column1: # Two columns, tab-separated: the input as space-separated hex code points, and
# String+Normalization.swift). An empty column is the empty string.
# The corpus is a seeded sample of characters that make the form interesting:
# case-folding pairs, compatibility characters, default-ignorables (soft hyphen,
# ZWJ, BOM, tag characters), combining marks, Hangul jamo, and emoji.
# Regenerate with `tools/generate_nfkc_fixture.swift` after a Swift or Unicode
# update — the inputs stay, the expectations are re-measured.
